questions.evidence: KPR or Kredit Pemilikan Rumah is the most common way to buy property
questions.explanation: KPR stands for Kredit Pemilikan Rumah, the mortgage loan Indonesians use to buy a house or apartment. The other options sound similar but are not the official term.
questions.question: In Indonesia, what does the abbreviation KPR stand for?

questions.evidence: the Sudirman-Thamrin corridor remains the prime central business district of Jakarta
questions.explanation: The Sudirman-Thamrin corridor is Jakarta's central business district, where most Grade A offices, hotels and the MRT line are concentrated. The other areas are mainly residential suburbs.
questions.question: Which Jakarta area is the city's main central business district, home to the Sudirman and Thamrin office towers?
questions.source_title: Jakarta Property Market Highlights | Knight Frank Indonesia

questions.evidence: apartment ownership is proven by SHMSRS, the certificate for a strata title unit
questions.explanation: An apartment unit is owned under SHMSRS, the strata title for a unit in a multi-storey building. SHM covers land, HGB is a building right, and girik is an outdated record.

options.A: SHM (Sertifikat Hak Milik) for the land
options.B: SHMSRS (Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun)
options.C: HGB (Hak Guna Bangunan) for the developer only
options.D: Girik, the old village land record

questions.question: What ownership certificate covers a single apartment unit in Indonesia?

questions.evidence: lower interest rates support housing demand and residential property price growth
questions.explanation: A lower benchmark rate makes bank funding cheaper, so KPR rates usually fall and monthly instalments drop, which brings more buyers into the market.

options.A: KPR rates fall and demand for homes usually rises
options.B: KPR rates rise and demand for homes usually falls
options.C: KPR rates stay fixed by law and demand does not change
options.D: KPR rates fall but banks stop lending for property

questions.question: When Bank Indonesia cuts its benchmark interest rate, what usually happens to KPR mortgage rates and buyer demand?
questions.source_title: Residential Property Price Survey | Bank Indonesia

questions.evidence: BPHTB is payable when acquiring rights over land and buildings
questions.explanation: BPHTB (Bea Perolehan Hak atas Tanah dan Bangunan) is the duty paid when someone acquires rights over land or a building, including a normal house purchase.

options.A: Rents out a property for the first time
options.B: Renovates a house above a certain size
options.C: Acquires land or building rights, such as buying a house
options.D: Lists a property for sale online

questions.question: BPHTB is a tax paid in Indonesia when a buyer does what?

questions.evidence: transit-oriented developments near MRT stations attract strong demand from commuters and investors
questions.explanation: TOD clusters housing, offices and shops within walking distance of a transit station, so residents rely less on cars. That walkability is why TOD apartments in Jakarta command a premium.

options.A: The building is only for transit workers
options.B: Homes, offices and shops are built close to the station so residents can walk to transit
options.C: The property cannot be sold for ten years
options.D: The building must include a bus terminal inside it

questions.question: What does transit-oriented development (TOD) mean for a Jakarta property near an MRT or LRT station?
questions.source_title: Jakarta Property Market Highlights | Knight Frank Indonesia

questions.evidence: check flood history and drainage before buying property in Jakarta
questions.explanation: Jakarta has well-known flood-prone pockets. A flood history means repair costs, harder insurance and buyers who discount the price, so it directly affects value.

options.A: Flood history determines the property tax rate
options.B: Flood-prone locations suffer damage, higher insurance costs and lower resale value
options.C: Flooded areas are illegal to sell in Jakarta
options.D: Flood history is only relevant for apartments above the 10th floor

questions.question: Why should a buyer always check a Jakarta property's flood history before buying?

questions.evidence: landed houses offer land ownership and space while apartments offer central locations
questions.explanation: A landed house gives you the land itself and more living space, but affordable landed houses tend to be in outer Jakarta, so the commute is longer than from a central apartment.

options.A: A landed house has land ownership and more space, but usually sits further from the city centre
options.B: A landed house is always cheaper than any apartment
options.C: A landed house needs no certificate at all
options.D: A landed house can never be rented out

questions.question: What is the main trade-off when choosing a landed house over an apartment in Jakarta?

questions.evidence: compare recent transactions of similar properties nearby to estimate market price
questions.explanation: A CMA estimates a fair listing price from recent sales of comparable homes nearby, adjusted for size, condition and location. The old purchase price or another city's prices do not set today's market value.

options.A: The seller's original purchase price from ten years ago
options.B: Recent sale prices of similar nearby properties
options.C: The asking prices of luxury homes in another city
options.D: The construction cost of the building alone

questions.question: When an agent prepares a comparative market analysis (CMA) for a Jakarta seller, what does the agent mainly use?

questions.evidence: the VAT rate rose to 11 percent in April 2022
questions.explanation: Indonesia raised VAT from 10% to 11% in April 2022, and that 11% rate applies to taxable property sales. Buyers should budget for it on top of the headline price.
questions.question: Since April 2022, what is the standard VAT (PPN) rate applied to new property sales in Indonesia?
